title: UP group slams PNP for seizing protesters food packs

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — University of the Philippines Against Pax Silica said police intercepted a vehicle carrying more than 300 rice meals, juice packs, and bottled water intended for protesters. Recently, protests erupted across Metro Manila as thousands of activists, students, and Indigenous peoples took to the streets to oppose the United States-led “Pax Silica” initiative
